# Run-3 fixtures: recorded bodies of GS1-L1 steps 6 and 7, chosen as the PR-1867 fixture specification asks (spec sha256 2bef4595a36f…)

Recording run-3 of the GS1-L1 sitting (TallyPrime 7.2, BRIDGE GST LEDGER LAB, the build of PR #1867 head 796e94f1, exe bf8cdf82…), recorder version e5dffc2b. Every body below is the response exactly as Tally sent it (no re-encoding). The whole recording (1,657 requests, 4,972 files) is listed by sha256 in `../recorder/run-3-SHA256.txt`; its bodies not committed here stay on the lab PC as hashed.

## How rows were assigned
- **Calls:** each call's receipt in `../egress/agent-egress.jsonl` records how many requests it sent: 102 for each of the 14 step-6 calls, 114 for step 7, 114 for step 8 (1,656 in all). Manifest row 1 is the `/status` equality check made by hand before step 6 (not a tool request). Calls took consecutive rows: step 6 call k = rows 2+102(k-1) to 103+102(k-1); step 7 = rows 1430 to 1543; step 8 = rows 1544 to 1657.
- **Kinds:** from the recorder template each request matched in full (the recorder's own matcher, rerun over the recorded requests): e `shape_lab_company_list`, s GET `/status`, b `shape_lab_book_extent`, c `shape_lab_currencies_1`, L `shape_lab_ledgers_1`, P `shape_lab_ledgers_2`, g `shape_lab_groups`, n `*_voucher_census_*` (each census request matches all three census templates, which differ only where the matcher allows), w `reference_date_class_window` (the entry-window template was never needed: no window came back empty), m `shape_lab_company_marks`. The manifest's collection IDs map one to one onto these kinds: no disagreement.
